messages:
merchantx_billing: Hey support — our May invoice for MerchantX (acct mx-879) looks wrong. The dashboard shows ~1.2M tokens on 2025-05-03 but the CSV usage export for that day has zero rows for our customer. Invoice ID INV-2025-05-MX879: https://billing.redwood.example/invoices/INV-2025-05-MX879
sophia_support: Sorry about that — can you paste the CSV path and one example invoice line? I can triage with data infra. :wave:
merchantx_billing: CSV path: s3://redwood-exports/merchantx/mx-879/2025/05/03/usage.csv
Here's the invoice line: `MX-879,2025-05-03,1,200,000,tokens,$1200`
Also attaching the customer report screenshot: https://img.redwood.example/merchantx-may3.png
javed_data: Thanks. Two quick checks: can someone run `aws s3 ls` on that path and also check the export job id in the export manifest? sometimes a worker wrote an empty file during a commit failure.
merchantx_billing: ran `aws s3 ls` — output: `2025-05-03 12:05:17 0 usage.csv` — file is 0 bytes :/
export_bot: Export job export-9432 finished: start=2025-05-03T11:58:01Z end=2025-05-03T12:05:20Z shards=8 rows_emitted=200000 rows_written=199999 shards_failed=1 (shard-7)
maria_backend: if shard-7 failed its commit we may have emitted rows upstream but the final consolidated file could be empty depending on our flush path. Can you paste the export manifest (manifest.json next to the CSV)?
merchantx_billing: manifest: s3://redwood-exports/merchantx/mx-879/2025/05/03/manifest.json — contents: `{"export_id":"export-9432","shards":[{"id":0,"rows":25000},{"id":7,"rows":0,"status":"failed","error":"WriteBatch: ErrCommitTimeout"}]}`
javed_data: That matches shard commit timeout. Quick repro to see raw events: run this query against raw_events to confirm the upstream store has the rows: ```sql
SELECT count(*) FROM raw_events WHERE customer_id='mx-879' AND date_trunc('day', ts)='2025-05-03';
```
I ran it on a read-replica and it returns `COUNT = 200000`. So events exist.
sophia_support: Ok—so events recorded but missing in CSV due to a shard commit failure. Customer-facing options: 1) backfill and publish corrected CSV (preferred), 2) issue invoice credit now and reconcile after backfill. Which do you want? :thinking_face:
merchantx_billing: We need this fixed before the billing cycle closes next Fri. Backfill + corrected CSV preferred. Also need assurance this won't reoccur — what caused the commit timeout?
maria_backend: Initial hypothesis: intermittent GC pause on one of the export workers that hit our S3 commit timeout (we've seen <1% in noisy nodes). The worker left shard-7 uncommitted which produced a 0-byte final file when consolidation assumed commit. We'll: (A) trigger a targeted backfill for shard-7, (B) harden commit retry logic and extend commit timeout for export jobs older than 1h, (C) add a healthcheck to avoid noisy nodes in export pool.
javed_data: Backfill command (ops run) we'll use: `./bin/export-backfill --export-id export-9432 --shard-id 7 --dst s3://redwood-exports/merchantx/mx-879/2025/05/03/usage.csv --consolidate` — this will reconstruct the missing rows from raw_events and stitch into the CSV. Running it requires ~30m of cluster time.
sophia_support: Estimated ETA if we start now: 48 hours for backfill + QA and then publish corrected export and regenerate reconciliation report. We can also issue a provisional invoice credit so the customer isn't blocked by the closing cycle. Do you want the provisional credit? :money_with_wings:
merchantx_billing: Please issue provisional credit for the missing day and proceed with backfill. Also send a short postmortem explaining the root cause and the mitigation timeline.
maria_backend: Roger. I'll kick off the backfill after a short window to drain noisy nodes. Credit request filed with billing (ticket BL-5843). Will post updates here and attach run logs.
export_bot: Backfill job backfill-1975 queued: expected duration ~35m, owner=@maria_backend
sophia_support: Thanks — we'll follow up with the customer with a timeline and an interim credit note. @merchantx_billing — we'll DM you as soon as the corrected CSV is published. :white_check_mark:
merchantx_billing: Thanks all. Please ping when done. Appreciated. :pray:
